payload.summary: DRAFT position (claude, pre-grill): freshness by DRIFT TEST, not generation and not trust. The doc docs/guide.md is hand-written prose (quickstart, entry-condition command map) around two reference tables (CLI verbs, /nd:* workflows); a bun test parses the tables and asserts two-way sync with src/cli.ts COMMANDS keys+descriptions and nahel/workflows frontmatter name/description/args — a new verb or workflow without a doc row fails CI, a stale row fails CI. Rationale: descriptions already live in code so the test is cheap and deterministic; pure hand-maintenance already failed once (observation swtjwvz5, born-broken doc examples); a full doc-generating verb is scope creep and makes prose ungeneratable. Per-verb DETAIL deliberately stays out of the doc — that is what this node's --help-exit-0 work ships, keeping the doc a router (ask-matt finding, ticket sgrgxr8j). Placement: docs/guide.md in the nahel repo, linked from README; the in-store surface for target repos remains nahel help + AGENTS.md section, which gains one pointer line to the guide.
